description: This file contains the implementation of a MemoryBufferWriter struct that implements the IBufferWriter<byte> interface. It provides methods to write to a memory buffer, including advancing the write position, obtaining memory spans, and handling capacity checks.

classes.name: MemoryBufferWriter
classes.description: A struct that implements IBufferWriter<byte> for writing to a Memory<byte> buffer.

methods.name: MemoryBufferWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the buffer and setting bytesWritten to zero.

methods.name: BytesWritten
methods.description: Property that returns the number of bytes written so far.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the current write position by the specified count, throwing if it exceeds buffer length.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> segment for writing, checking capacity constraints.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> segment for writing, checking capacity constraints.
